And, but the Medevac Plain was the hardest. I went to the White House, I went to the DOD State Department, went to Stuttgart, Africa, all of those places of government but also volunteers, and then finally made contact with Reverend Franklin Graham, Samaritan's Purse, and I explained the situation to him in about three minutes as all it took, and he said, I have a DC-8 that can fly them out of Africa. So he flew the Samaritan's Purse DCA to big plane into Africa and loaded those three kids up in a medivac facilities that they'd set up on the plane, flew them back to Sioux City, and a week later, they had undergone surgery to repair those three children, their shattered bodies.
